title: The Baguette Line
subtitle: Step-cut diamonds set flat and forward, a cool line around the throat.

stone.origin: Natural. Step-cut diamonds matched edge-to-edge around the neck.

description: A necklace drawn as one continuous line of baguette diamonds, each stone matched edge to edge and set flat and forward so the light lies calm around the neck. There is no cluster, no centrepiece — only the discipline of the step cut repeated with precision, returning light in long architectural planes rather than scattered fire. It follows the throat exactly, made to fit, in eighteen-karat gold or platinum. Worn, it reads as a single cool band of light.
